purpose: One finite-budget sweep of canonical_backbone recovery in the primary HCC GEARS analysis, grounded in the formal backbone diagnostic summary; do not expand the analysis scope.
allowed_runtime_notes: Checkpoint selection is limited to last/best within the same training trajectory; model architecture must not change.
HCC-specific materialization/export is limited to sanity checks; do not modify the truth-aligned contract.
disallowed_changes: Promoting cosine/L2/top-20 to primary adjudication criteria
Open-ended tuning beyond one finite-budget round
stop_rule: If one finite sweep does not bring canonical_backbone recovery close to or level with shared_mean_baseline, and improvements substantially reduce structure/context separation, stop promoting GEARS as the primary HCC winner and report an architecture trade-off diagnosis.
